name: strata-language
description: Schema-aware completions, hovers, symbols, imports, and native compiler diagnostics for .strata applications.

strata.compiler.path.description: Path to the installed strata_compile executable. Relative paths resolve from the workspace folder.

strata.desktopRunner.path.description: Path to strata_desktop. Relative paths resolve from the workspace folder.

strata.applicationSchemas.path.description: Application *.schemas.json used for validation and app-specific completions. Empty discovers a schema beside the module.

strata.extensions.paths.description: Directories containing external native extension libraries. Relative paths resolve from the workspace folder.

strata.validation.onSave.description: Run the native compiler when a Strata document is opened or saved.
